name: China Chic Girl
detailed_description:
Contact Us

Si vous avez besoin de contacter notre développeur "China Chic Girl", envoyez-nous un e-mail et nous vérifierons.

Courriel de contact : 3926061224@QQ.COM

Le jeu sortira en version d'essai gratuite le 10 juin. Si vous aimez jouer, vous pouvez cliquer sur la liste de souhaits !


Based on true events

For a while, the author ordered Guochao-style takeout almost every day, and ate too much. As a result, one night, I dreamed of a mysterious Guochao girl. She came out of the dream, with ancient charm and a hint of mystery, and then a series of surreal things happened...

Is this an illusion caused by eating too much Guochao takeout, or is another world really opening its door to me? It is still a mystery.

🤯So, I decided to make this wonderful experience into a game


About the Game

The game is in mid-development. If you want to play it, you can click " Wishlist " and " Follow ".

Hello! My name is Guochao Youmi!

Almost every time you order takeout, you can order Guochao takeout. I really miss you!

Seeing you eating with relish, I am so happy!

Today I can finally meet you in person~

Let's enjoy delicious Chinese takeaways together~

If we are together, I can make you Chinese takeaways every day. I know you like it very much!

Let's enjoy delicious Chinese takeaways together~

If we are together, I can make you Chinese takeaways every day. I know you like it very much!

"Guochao is Coming" is a first-person love puzzle game that combines cute and light horror elements. Players will enter a fantasy and horror Guochao world, and start a unique adventure through puzzle solving and love interaction.

Game features:

"Guochao is Coming" is a first-person love puzzle game that combines cute and light horror elements. Players will enter a fantasy and horror Guochao world, and start a unique adventure through puzzle solving and love interaction.

Game features:

First-person perspective experience: Interact with "Guochao Youmi" through the first-person perspective to experience every interesting conversation and thrilling moment

Love and puzzle coexist: Not only solve the puzzles in the game, but also play with the characters with distinctive personalities to promote the plot and explore their respective stories and secrets

Multiple endings: According to the player's choice, the story direction is affected, bringing a variety of endings. The game has a total of three endings!

Unique art style: Combining cute and light horror elements to create a fantasy and slightly suspenseful Guochao world

Various tasks and challenges: Unlock new tasks, collect clues, solve puzzles, and continue to advance the plot in the game

Game engine: UE Unreal Engine 5 development and production

short_description: After working overtime in the early morning, I spent half an hour ordering a takeaway. When I opened the package and took the first bite, a girl with a Chinese style suddenly appeared. Is this a hallucination caused by eating takeaway? !
supported_languages:
English, Simplified Chinese*, French, Italian, German, Spanish - Spain, Ukrainian, Russian, Hungarian, Indonesian, Turkish, Czech, Japanese*, Polish, Thai, Traditional Chinese*, Romanian, Finnish, Portuguese - Brazil, Portuguese - Portugal, Spanish - Latin America, Korean
*languages with full audio support
